name: Media Library Alt Text Editor
author: Brainvire

sections.description:
Media Library Alt Text Editor helps improve your website’s accessibility and SEO by allowing you to quickly add or modify the alt text of images.

Key Features:

  • Edit alt text directly from the media listing page.
  • Bulk update alt text by copying image names to alt text for selected images or all images.
  • Improve accessibility and SEO by ensuring every image has appropriate alt text.
  • Simple, user-friendly interface integrated into the existing media library.

How It Works:

  1. Access the Media Library from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Enter the alt text for the desired images you want to update.
  3. Edit the alt text field directly or use the bulk update feature to copy image names into the alt text fields.
  4. Save the changes, and your images will now have the updated alt text.

This plugin is ideal for anyone looking to optimize their site’s accessibility and search engine performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the media-library-alt-text-editor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Media Library and start editing alt text for your images.
sections.faq:
How do I bulk update alt text for all images?

On the media listing page, from the Bulk actions dropdown you can either “Update Images Alt Text” or “Copy Images Names to Alt Text” option.
The option “Update Images Alt Text” will update alt text for selected images as the text given in the input field in Alt Text column.
The option “Copy Images Names to Alt Text” will update image title or name (post title) into alt text either for selected images or for all images.

Does this plugin work with all image formats?

Yes, this plugin supports all image formats in the WordPress Media Library.
